services.desc: Premier Horse Camping Weekend Rates Riders - $700 Non-Riders - $100 Duration 3 Days About Theses camping trips are only offered in May 2026 dates: May 1-3 May 8-10 May 15-17 This exciting weekend will pack in as much riding as you can handle at beautiful Wildcat Mountain located in Ontario, WI. The 3,603 acre, mostly wooded, park has breathtaking views and fifteen miles of trail exclusively for horseback riding. The campground has picnic tables, fire rings, drinking water, vault toilets, a corral, and hitching posts. You bring yourself, a tent or camper and we’ll provide the horses, food and campfires. Camping fees and trail passes are included in your fees. You meet us at Wildcat Mountain
